lines.beaver: 좋은 아침이에요. 얼굴이 많이 피곤해 보여요.
lines.beaver_en: Good morning. You look really tired.
lines.beaver_roman: joeun achimieyo. eolguri mani pigonhae boyeoyo.
lines.en: Yes, I stayed up almost all night.

lines.beaver_en: Why? Did you get home late?
lines.en: Yes, I got home at 2 a.m.

lines.beaver: 일이 많았나 봐요. 평소엔 잘 자요?
lines.beaver_en: You must have had a lot of work. Do you usually sleep well?
lines.beaver_roman: iri mananna bwayo. pyeongsoen jal jayo?
lines.en: No, I can't fall asleep well these days.

lines.learner: 걱정은 아니고, 남편이 코를 심하게 골아요.
lines.en: Not worries. My husband snores really loudly.
lines.roman: geokjeongeun anigo, nampyeoni koreul simhage gorayo.

lines.beaver_en: Ah, so that's why you couldn't sleep.
lines.en: I finally fell asleep, but then I had a nightmare.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of dream was it?
lines.en: Even in my dream, I stayed up all night working.

lines.beaver_en: That must have been hard. You're sleepy now, right?
lines.learner: 네, 졸음이 와서 오늘 실수할지도 몰라요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm drowsy, so I might make mistakes today.
lines.roman: ne, joreumi waseo oneul silsuhaljido mollayo.

lines.beaver_en: Stand up for a moment and stretch.
lines.en: Okay. Stretching makes me feel a bit better.

lines.beaver_en: Does that happen often these days?
lines.learner: 밤을 새우는 게 요즘 제 일상이 됐어요.
lines.en: Staying up all night has become my daily life lately.
lines.roman: bameul saeuneun ge yojeum je ilsangi dwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그건 건강에 안 좋아요. 오늘은 일찍 자요.
lines.beaver_en: That's bad for your health. Go to bed early tonight.
lines.beaver_roman: geugeon geongange an joayo. oneureun iljjik jayo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll start by changing my lifestyle habits.
